svg.title: Blade Reader
svg.desc: A neon sign reading Blade Reader over a rain-soaked city at night (or an orange haze by day). Beside it, a comb-shaped circuit board clamped to six blade fuses, each with a glowing current reading, and a vertical katakana sign.
svg.text: CURRENT ON EVERY WAY OF A BLADE FUSE PANEL
I'VE SEEN THINGS YOU PEOPLE WOULDN'T BELIEVE.
FRIDGES DRAWING AMPS OFF THE SHOULDER OF ORION.
